title: Janssons Frestelse
description: A traditional dish from Sweden, centered on potato, yellow onion, anchovy fillets, heavy cream. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. A home adaptation using catalog anchovy fillets; Swedish-style sprats typically used for Janssons frestelse are not cataloged.

steps.instruction: Slice potatoes into thin matchsticks, onion finely and anchovy into strips. Layer evenly in a buttered baking dish.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Pour over the cream mixture, dot with butter and breadcrumbs, bake at 190°C until bubbly and the potatoes are tender.
